visual_goal: Show the configuration layers as a dependency graph rooted in the entity register, converging on one go-live gate through posting simulation, settlement matching and controls scoping.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration shaped like three railway lines that start from one station and end at one gate. At the far left, a large root-like foundation block labeled 'Entity register', with plant roots drawn beneath it. From it, three parallel horizontal lanes run to the right. Upper lane: a card 'Dimensions', then a card 'Posting rules', then a checkpoint station 'Posting simulation'. Middle lane: two small stacked cards 'PSP accounts' and 'Bank accounts', then a checkpoint station 'Matching profile'. Lower lane: two small stacked cards 'Close calendar' and 'Consolidation', then a checkpoint station 'Controls scoping'. Each lane is a straight line of arrows from left to right. At the far right, the three lanes converge into one large gate with an open barrier, labeled 'Go-live gate'. A small green check mark sits above each checkpoint station.
alt: Three lanes starting from the entity register: dimensions and posting rules to posting simulation, PSP and bank accounts to the matching profile, close calendar and consolidation to controls scoping, all converging on one go-live gate.
